language.title: Language
language.label: Interface language
language.help: Applies to labels in the app. Generated content, prompts and file names stay as they are.

services.nsfwPublic: NSFW is unavailable with public LLM providers ({{provider}}). Switch to a local or self-hosted model to enable.
services.nsfwOn: Adult content generation is enabled. LLM prompts include explicit content guidance. Use responsibly.
services.nsfwOff: Content safety guardrails active. Explicit content is blocked in all LLM outputs.
services.nsfwRead: Please read and accept before continuing
services.nsfwLead: By enabling NSFW mode, you acknowledge and agree to the following:
services.nsfwAge: 1. Age Requirement. You confirm that you are at least 18 years of age (or the age of majority in your jurisdiction, whichever is higher).
services.nsfwLegal: 2. Legal Responsibility. You are solely responsible for ensuring that all content you generate complies with the laws of your jurisdiction. This includes but is not limited to laws governing obscenity, pornography, intellectual property, privacy, consent, and the depiction of real persons. HocusPocus and its developers do not monitor, review, or approve generated content.
services.nsfwProhibited: 3. Prohibited Content. You agree to NEVER use this software to generate child sexual abuse material (CSAM) or any content depicting minors in sexual or exploitative contexts. This is strictly prohibited regardless of jurisdiction and may constitute a criminal offense.
services.nsfwPersons: 4. No Real Person Exploitation. You agree not to generate non-consensual intimate imagery of real, identifiable individuals. Creating realistic explicit content of someone without their consent may violate laws in your jurisdiction.
services.nsfwLocal: 5. Local Generation. When using local models, all content is generated on your hardware and is never transmitted to external servers. You are responsible for the storage, distribution, and use of any content you create.
services.nsfwPublicApi: 6. Public API Providers. NSFW mode is automatically disabled when using public LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic) as it violates their terms of service. NSFW mode is only available with local or self-hosted models.
services.nsfwWarranty: 7. No Warranty. This software is provided as-is. The developers assume no liability for content generated by users. You use this feature entirely at your own risk.
services.nsfwScroll: Scroll to the bottom to enable the accept button.
services.profileHint: Credential-free defaults for Studio, Story Lab, Series Lab, Comics and Director. Projects can inherit these values or keep an explicit override.
services.minimaxMusicWarn: MiniMax Music is closed for most accounts and will error if you select it. Prefer a local ACE-Step model.
services.profileDefaults: Using built-in defaults until the first change.
services.profileSizeHint: Unsupported video sizes are resolved to the closest model-supported size without flipping orientation.
services.urlOllama: Type the Ollama IP/URL by hand, then Refresh to list models via /api/tags. /v1 is optional.
services.urlRemote: URL of your LM Studio or other OpenAI-compatible server
services.urlMinimax: MiniMax OpenAI-compatible API base; leave blank to use https://api.minimax.io.
services.urlGrok: xAI OpenAI-compatible API base; leave blank to use https://api.x.ai.
services.urlOpenAi: OpenAI API base URL; leave blank to use the default.
services.localModelHint: Larger models produce more creative scene descriptions but use more RAM
services.testIdle: Run a quick hello check against the configured model/provider.
services.cpuHint: CPU recommended to avoid conflicts with video generation
services.providerKeysHint: LLM, image and music MiniMax keys are stored separately even if you paste the same value twice. A blank specific field still falls back to the legacy shared MiniMax key.
services.enhancerHint: The sparkle button in Studio mode. Uses model-specific prompt guides for best results. Set a separate LLM here or leave empty to use the Director LLM above.
services.enhanceSeparate: Separate LLM for Studio enhancement — lighter/faster than Director.
services.enhanceShared: Using the Director LLM for enhancement (may be slower but more capable).
services.wan2gpHint: When enabled, overrides the LLM enhancer above. Uses Wan2GP's built-in pipeline (does NOT use our model-specific prompt guides).
services.directorV2Hint: Layered architecture with structured shot planning, mode-specific renderers, and prompt validation. Supports Podcast and Viral Video skills. Turn off to use the legacy v1 engine.
services.polishFullHint: Legacy: injects the complete model-specific prompt guide into the Director planner's system prompt.
services.polishLightHint: Legacy: injects a lightweight dialect cheat sheet (~200 tokens) into the Director planner.
services.polishOffHint: Uses the complete prompts produced and validated by Director, with no additional LLM calls.
services.polishThirdHint: Default and model-aware. H3 keeps its native video prompts while generated image prompts may still be polished; other models use their dialect-specific enhance pipeline.
services.parallelHint: Overlaps work only across different servers or devices. Each local GPU and each remote host remains a sequential queue.
services.debugHint: Saves sanitized LLM requests/results and user actions as JSONL. Off by default.
services.multishotHint: Emits storyboard-format prompts for 20s shots so an IC-LoRA (e.g. Maque AI LTX-2.3) can cut between camera angles inside one generation. Add the matching LoRA to your video LoRA selection for cuts to render. Short and long-sustained shots stay single-camera.
services.voiceHint: Adds a voice-sample dropzone to Studio Video and Director for speaker identity preservation across clips. HocusPocus loads the matching ID-LoRA when a reference is supplied. Enabled by default.
services.flashHint: DiT super-resolution. Pick it per generation in Post Processing → Spatial Upsampling. First use downloads ~4 GB of weights.
services.flashFullHint: Full uses the complete Wan2.1 VAE — sharpest detail and best temporal fidelity, highest VRAM.
services.flashTinyLongHint: Tiny decoder tuned for long clips.
services.flashTinyHint: Lightweight decoder — fastest, lowest VRAM. Good default alongside the main model on a 24 GB card.
services.flashTopkHint: Higher computes more attention → better motion fidelity, slower. 0 = sparsest (fastest).
services.flashBackendHint: SpargeAttn gives the best quality when there's motion but needs a separate install. Auto uses the bundled Triton kernels otherwise.
services.comicHint: Credentials remain in HocusPocus settings and are never embedded in an exported comic.
services.compatibleHint: Used only by the custom comic-writing profile. Local servers may leave the key empty.
services.civitaiHint: Optional. Increases rate limits and enables access to restricted models.
services.betaHint: Reveals features still under development. Some are incomplete, unstable, or require additional setup. Default off keeps the UI focused on features known to work well.
services.betaGates: Currently gates: external LLM APIs (Google / OpenAI / Anthropic), Studio Prompt Enhancer config, and the Inpaint edit mode.

modelOptions.conditioningHint: FL2VA preserves the supplied first frame. Ref2VA composes a new shot from image/video/audio references and cannot guarantee an exact opening frame.
modelOptions.profileHint: INT4 is retried automatically only if INT8 runs out of VRAM. The selected FL2VA or Ref2VA checkpoint downloads on first use.
modelOptions.audioPlaceholder: Ambience, dialogue, music and sound effects for the clip
modelOptions.audioHint: Appended as Audio: when the main prompt has no audio clause. Director adds each shot's planned ambience, effects and dialogue automatically.

loraBrowser.title: Model Browser
loraBrowser.importUrlTitle: Import LoRA from HuggingFace or CivitAI URL
loraBrowser.urlPlaceholder: HuggingFace repo or CivitAI model URL
loraBrowser.urlHint: Paste a HuggingFace model URL. Downloads the LoRA, saves metadata, example media, and generates a usage guide.
loraBrowser.noKeyBody: Most NSFW, restricted, and early-access LoRAs require a key to download — without one, those downloads will fail with an error.
loraBrowser.getKeyTitle: Opens CivitAI's account page in a new tab — scroll to 'API Keys'
loraBrowser.pasteKeyTitle: Opens Settings → Services where you can paste your key
loraBrowser.updatesFilterTitle: {{count}} LoRA(s) have updates available — check to filter
loraBrowser.updatesNoneTitle: No updates available — click Check to refresh from CivitAI
loraBrowser.checkingLoras: Checking CivitAI for newer LoRA versions…
loraBrowser.checkLoras: Check CivitAI for newer LoRA versions
loraBrowser.linkedTitle: From a linked install's loras folder (read-only) — guides and metadata are stored in HocusPocus
loraBrowser.confirmDelete: Click again to permanently delete this LoRA (weights + metadata + guide)
loraBrowser.tryFilters: Try different search terms or filters
loraBrowser.checkCheckpoints: Check CivitAI for newer checkpoint versions
loraBrowser.switchToSearch: Switch to the search grid and import one from CivitAI
loraBrowser.updateOpen: Update available — open to re-import the latest version
loraBrowser.importHint: The base model this checkpoint was trained for{{base}}. It'll be registered as a new selectable model.
loraBrowser.optimizeHint: Recommended for large checkpoints — runs at roughly half the VRAM with minimal quality loss.
loraBrowser.noKeyInline: No CivitAI API key set. Most NSFW or restricted LoRAs will fail to download.

storage.title: Storage Manager
storage.duplicatesHint: same file in HocusPocus AND a linked install — deleting HocusPocus's copy is free, the linked one keeps working
storage.allowLinkedTitle: The inverse direction: keep HocusPocus's copy and remove the duplicate FROM the linked install. Removals go to the Windows Recycle Bin so they can be undone. Off by default because it modifies other installs.
storage.conflicts: {{count}} same-name files differ in size between installs (not listed as reclaimable — HocusPocus's copy is the one in use).
storage.sharesWeightsTitle: This entry runs on {{name}}'s weights — delete that row to free the space. Its own extras (like a bundled accelerator LoRA) are tiny.
storage.linkedOnlyTitle: Every copy of these weights lives in a linked install (read-only from here). Free the space in that install, or unlink it.
storage.linkedLoraTitle: Lives in a linked install's loras folder (read-only from here) — no delete. Free the space in that install, or unlink it.
storage.modelSizeTitle: {{primary}} deletable here; the rest lives in linked installs or belongs to a base model
